issue: Manacles F3 mismatches at image row y=44 after correct 40x22 geometry
root_cause: Unity Manacles F3 call did not supply sampleTopDown:true, so bottom-up GetPixels32 mapping selected source row 13 instead of DOS row 12 at screen y=44

patch.single_caller_change: append roundBiasOverride:0, sampleTopDown:true to GetManaclesGeneratedF3FrontTexture() GenerateDmScaledWallDecoration call

caveat: Brown ornament mask match proven from screenshots. All RGB/palette pixels still require an independent screenshot after Unity patch.
